description: Figure 4 is a line plot titled "Hidden State Mean" that illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different network layers, comparing three conditions: before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The horizontal x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The vertical y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate" (average 0.71), which remains relatively low and flat until layer 18, then rises sharply to a value of approximately 4.2 by layer 22; an orange dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate" (average 0.05), which stays consistently near zero across all layers; and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline" (average 0.04), which also remains near zero, closely tracking the post-gating line. The caption notes that the baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually confirmed by the near-overlapping green and orange lines.
